diagnostic.note: The timed executable predates the final cfg(test) loss-refusal module. The retained source prefix was reconstructed after measurement by removing only the final test module; it is not a contemporaneous whole-file source snapshot. The final example/clippy gate includes the appended test. Runtime code did not change after timed runs.

corpus.scope: Complete source-only private copy of actual Riemann inventory. Every indexed source digest and all byte counts match original cached observations; complete source bytes and complete original expected record copies checked. Actual semantic preparation is excluded; compiler objects and Lake metadata are not copied. Original workspace lease and files remain intact.

sampling.scope: Complete actual-source private corpus and original cached File values, actual confined workers and unchanged policy/bounds. Cold, unchanged explicit refresh and sealed resume; setup and complete output comparison excluded from intervals. Physical metadata stamps belong to the private copy and are not compared to original inode hints. No compiler, model, accepted evidence or cold-install claim. Sampling is diagnostic and must be calibrated against quiet runs; thread CPU excludes child processes and parallel/nested wall intervals overlap.

quiet.scope: Complete actual-source private corpus and original cached File values, actual confined workers and unchanged policy/bounds. measurement.scope: One sampling and one quiet run, in that order, on the same complete private corpus with separate fresh host-data directories and the same fixed worker. Not a population percentile or universal overhead estimate. All complete File values match after every phase. Fixed batch phase walls overlap across four workers; sources includes nested collection/index spans. Parent/child wall and CPU intervals must not be added; host thread CPU excludes child processes. Quantiles are sorted floor((n-1)*q) observations. Native wall excludes setup and complete original-output comparison/hash work.
